summary.zh: 会话量预测缓升但拟合度中等；平均跳出率55.3%，结局转化率5.8%。
summary.en: Sessions are forecast to rise modestly with moderate fit; mean bounce is 55.3%, and ending conversion is 5.8%.

riskiestCohort.zh: 首页到开始环节流失41.5%，首屏访客最危险。
riskiestCohort.en: Homepage visitors who do not press start are the highest-risk group.

actions.actionZh: 拆查首页首屏到开始按钮的流失点并发布单变量改版。
actions.actionEn: Identify first-screen drop-offs and ship a single-variable homepage test.
actions.rationaleZh: 5005人抵达首页，仅2928人开始；该步流失41.5%，平均跳出率55.3%。
actions.rationaleEn: Only 2,928 of 5,005 visitors pressed start; this step loses 41.5%, with 55.3% mean bounce.
actions.metric: 「抵达首页→按下开始」转化率：58.5%→至少63%（建议验收）
actions.riskZh: 按钮改版可能造成误触；同时监测开始后的进入率。
actions.riskEn: A button change may increase accidental taps; also monitor start-to-world entry.

landed.change: 首屏新增 30 秒上手直链教程角标（goto-guide）；同时修正旧文案「八十一篇」→「八十五篇」
landed.targetMetric: 「抵达首页→按下开始」转化率：58.5%→至少63%（建议验收）

actions.actionZh: 复现谱册页面的愤怒点击并修复对应无响应控件。
actions.actionEn: Reproduce ledger-page rage clicks and fix the unresponsive control.
actions.rationaleZh: 谱册页记录213次愤怒点击；尚无该页访问量，不能计算点击率。
actions.rationaleEn: The ledger page recorded 213 rage clicks; page visits are unavailable, so its rate cannot be calculated.
actions.metric: 谱册页愤怒点击数：213→不高于150（同等观测窗口，建议验收）
actions.riskZh: 修复可能改变谱册操作路径；回归检查阅读与翻页。
actions.riskEn: The fix may change ledger interactions; regression-test reading and page navigation.

actions.actionZh: 检查读完正文后的结局入口与状态保存，补齐断点。
actions.actionEn: Audit ending access and progress persistence after article completion.
actions.rationaleZh: 680人读完正文，仅289人抵达结局，后续转化约42.5%。
actions.rationaleEn: Of 680 article completers, 289 reached an ending, a downstream conversion of about 42.5%.
actions.metric: 「读完正文→抵达结局」转化率：42.5%→至少48%（建议验收）
actions.riskZh: 入口提示可能剧透；测试中确认不提前暴露结局。
actions.riskEn: Prompts may spoil the story; verify they do not reveal endings early.

actions.actionZh: 在压测同等负载下定位慢端点并压低公开页传输量。
actions.actionEn: Profile slow endpoints and reduce public-page payload under the same stress load.
actions.rationaleZh: 压测470次请求覆盖94个端点、零失败，但尾部响应达1445毫秒，传输量16.1兆字节。
actions.rationaleEn: Stress testing had 470 requests across 94 endpoints and zero failures, but p95 was 1,445 ms and payload was 16.1 MB.
actions.metric: 同负载压测的百分之九十五响应时间：1445毫秒→不高于1000毫秒（建议验收）
actions.riskZh: 缓存或压缩可能导致公开镜像内容过期；核验版本一致性。
actions.riskEn: Caching or compression may stale public mirrors; verify version consistency.

sensitivity.zh: 首页跳出率最敏感：55.3%的访客未继续，直接限制后续结局人数。
sensitivity.en: Homepage bounce is most sensitive: 55.3% do not continue, limiting downstream endings.
